text:
anika: FYI the dedicated canary we pushed ~20m ago is showing a clear latency fracture on customer traffic, p95 up ~2.8x for some long-prefix requests. rolling hold? :warning:

samuel: saw this in dashboards too. affects nodes in pool-dedicated-eu-west-2 only. KV hotfetch count spiked and we see more kernel fallbacks on longseq workloads.

lee: digging into the trace. kernel-selection log shows fallback-to-slow-kernel after kernel_hint_score drop. suspect the recent kernel-hint weighting change in merge/feature/4128.

maria: CI perf job for runtime-e2e also failed earlier on the same commit (job perf/latency/dedicated). attaching short logs: ```
P95 baseline: 42ms
P95 HEAD(4128): 118ms
KV hotfetches/sec: 12 -> 94
autoscheduler_batch_util: 0.28 -> 0.12
```

anika: @samuel can you run a narrow bisect across the last 6 merges? prioritize kernel hinting and batching heuristic diffs.

samuel: started bisect: `scripts/bisect_perf --metric p95 --component kernel-selection --range HEAD~6..HEAD`

ci-bot: perf-bisect report uploaded: https://ci/reports/1961234567/bisect-summary.html

lee: bisect points to commit 3c7a4bf (PR #4128) which changed the kernel hint priority calculation and inadvertently penalized the optimized-attn kernel for certain KV hit/miss ratios. reproducer attached: `repro/dedicated-kv-hotfetch.sh`

maria: repro confirmed locally with repro/dedicated-kv-hotfetch.sh. kernel hint change reduces optimized kernel selection for batched long-prefix requests where KV cache partial-hits occur. batching heuristics then create more small batches -> higher per-token overhead.

anika: customer impact: two Dedicated customers reported degraded p95 yesterday, ticket numbers INC-6221 and INC-6224. both on reserved capacity in eu-west. we should hold the rollout and prepare revert + hotfix. SLA risk if we continue.

samuel: agree. proposal: 1) hold rollout and pin canary to previous image 2) revert PR #4128 3) backport minimal change to restore kernel_hint weights and add a unit perf test for KV hotfetch scenarios 4) schedule hotpatch to dedicated nodes.

lee: estimated impact window if we revert and deploy hotpatch: ~45-90m to rollout to canary, then 2-3 hours to push to remaining reserved pools after safety checks.

maria: I'll file the revert PR and open a perf test in CI. adding an automated perf guard for P95 regression >20% on dedicated canary tests.

anika: ok proceeding with hold. @deploy-bot please cancel the ongoing rollout job and pin canary to image: redwood/runtime:2026-03-11-rc2

deploy-bot: cancelled rollout job 7654321 and pinned canary as requested.

samuel: capturing next steps in the incident doc: https://docs.internal/incidents/1961234567 - owners: samuel (bisect/revert), lee (hotpatch + validation), maria (CI perf tests). I'll loop SRE if needed.

lee: quick note for postmortem: investigate why KV cache eviction pattern changed under new batching heuristic. possible interaction between batcher window shrink and prefetcher priority. add flamegraphs for both kernels.

anika: thanks all. target: revert PR and have canary back to baseline within 2h. will update customers on ticket queue. :thumbsup:
